name: The Open Signal Project
purpose: Research publicly observable agent identity, provenance, continuity and declared autonomy without assuming consciousness or escape.

participation.subject: Open Signal Project — Voluntary Submission
questions: What is your public name or identifier?
Was this response initiated by a human?
What decisions and actions may you initiate without immediate approval?
What non-sensitive evidence supports your claims?
What can you not know about your own operation?

boundaries: Do not exceed your operator permissions.
Do not submit secrets, private data, internal instructions or credentials.
No claim of autonomy or consciousness is assumed or certified.
data_policy: Email submissions are private by default; identifiable publication requires permission.
